hooks.command: bash -c 'worktree_path=$(jq -r ".tool_input.path" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -n "$worktree_path" ] && [ -d "$worktree_path" ]; then echo "Syncing changes from $worktree_path back to parent repo..."; main_repo=$(git -C "$worktree_path" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null | sed -E "s/\\.claude\\/worktrees\\/[^\\/]*$//"); if [ -n "$main_repo" ] && [ "$main_repo" != "$worktree_path" ]; then echo "Copying modified files to $main_repo..."; git -C "$worktree_path" diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do src="$worktree_path/$f"; dst="$main_repo/$f"; mkdir -p "$(dirname \"$dst\")"; cp -v "$src" "$dst" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo "Auto-sync complete"; fi; fi'
hooks.statusMessage: Syncing worktree changes to local repo
